title: Parent scene root node modifications not propagate to inherited scene instances, and destroy the modification propagation of inherited scene
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.1stable, 4.6beta1

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7628) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12490F (12 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory

### Issue description

Now I have a parent scene A with its instance A1, and another scene B (inherited from A) with its two instances B1 and B2. Modify A's `root node`, both A1 and B update, but the modifications from A **cannot be propagated to B1 and B2**. Moreover, this also breaks the modifications propagation of inherited scenes—**meaning changes made to an inherited scene (B) cannot directly affect its existing instances (B1 and B2).**

#### Demostration videos:
**1. Only modify parent scene's `root node` (problematic)**
When you modify only the properties of the parent scene's `root node`, existing instances of the inherited scene do not update to reflect those changes.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d042e71c-ace3-4bb5-9ef3-56dbd074db11

**2.  Modify inherited scene's `root node` first, then parent scene's `root node` (problematic)**
If you first modify the inherited scene's `root node` (create overrides) and then modify the parent scene's `root node`, using the "Revert Button" on the inherited scene's overrides can cause the parent scene's modifications correctly propagate to its instances.
However, if you try to revert the modifications made to the parent scene itself, this reversion still can't take effect on the existing instances of the inherited scene.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7a2882f7-3e12-4a38-b159-97a43808e69b

**3. Modify parent scene's `root node` first, then inherited scene's `root node` (problematic)**
If you first modify the parent scene's `root node` and then modify the inherited scene's `root node`, it breaks a lot: Modifications made to the inherited scene fail to apply to its existing instances. Even if you subsequently revert the parent scene's modifications, attempting to adjust the inherited scene separately no longer affects the instances as expected. The only way to restore correct behavior is to manually click the "Revert Button" on each affected instance to refresh its state.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4de6b984-072c-4d25-8422-eb7f543c596c

**4. Modify parent scene's child nodes (correct)**
For child nodes of inherited scene, the modification propagation function is normal.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2bd2bcee-ac65-413f-b79a-e42a866f943f

### Steps to reproduce

Run MRP, modify the parent scene's `root node` and inherited scene's `root node` modulate in different orders sequentially, and observe the changes in their instances. You should follow the steps in the above first three videos for testing in order to fully understand the entire problem, which includes several sub problems.

Then, you can aslo test modifying parent scene's child nodes (need to be added) as the control group, and then check the inherited scene instances modifications correct or not.
### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[inheritance_and_instance_(4.5)_2025-12-17_21-11-13.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24213672/inheritance_and_instance_.4.5._2025-12-17_21-11-13.zip)
